parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Pushed destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-pushed` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Pushed destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Pushed destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"app_key":"${ customer_secrets.PUSHED_APP_KEY }","app_secret":"${ customer_secrets.PUSHED_APP_SECRET }","target_type":"app","content":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and ": " or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
